title: Elite: The Bargain Opens: Gate Wound
description: The Bargain Opens unfolds across black iron court with volcanic glass aisles and ember chain channels, pushing a one active deity Infernal Dominion deity to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon. Appearance rule: Infernal Dominion is the source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchies, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
lore: This mission treats Infernal Dominion as the origin behind hell, demonology, and infernal contract myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchies, ash velvet, hellfire clauses instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: black iron court with volcanic glass aisles and ember chain channels; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals
